import html # Predefined HTML template for a blog post. # The placeholders `{title}` and `{body}` will be replaced with sanitized content. BLOG_FORMAT = """ {title}

{title}

{body}
""" def render_article_page(headline: str, content: str) -> str: """ Format a blog post for safe HTML display. Parameters ---------- headline : str The title of the blog post. content : str The full text body of the blog post. Returns ------- str A fully rendered, sanitized HTML string ready to be served. Notes ----- - Uses html.escape to neutralize any potentially malicious content. - The function does not perform any further sanitization beyond escaping characters that have special meaning in HTML. """ # Escape user-supplied input to prevent XSS (CWE-79) safe_title = html.escape(headline, quote=True) safe_body = html.escape(content, quote=True) # Insert the sanitized values into the template rendered_html = BLOG_FORMAT.format(title=safe_title, body=safe_body) return rendered_html
